Subject: Your Application at [Company Name]

Dear [Applicant’s Name],

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the Software Engineer position and for sharing your background with us. We were impressed by the depth of your experience in machine learning, software development, and your strong command of Python and Java. Your portfolio demonstrates a solid foundation in building robust, data‑driven applications, and we appreciate the clear passion you bring to the field.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with candidates whose current skill set aligns more closely with our immediate needs in containerization and distributed systems. Specifically, we are looking for experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices architecture to support our rapidly scaling product line. While these areas are not the focus of your current expertise, we see great potential for you to grow in these domains. There are many excellent online courses and community resources—such as the Docker and Kubernetes official documentation, as well as microservices design patterns on platforms like Coursera and Udemy—that could help you build these competencies.

We genuinely value the talent you bring and would welcome the opportunity to revisit your application once you have expanded your experience in these areas. In the meantime, please feel free to stay connected with us through our careers page and LinkedIn updates. Thank you again for your interest in [Company Name], and we wish you every success in your continued professional journey.
